headline: Virginia would bar permits for data center siting
text:
Here is how your fear of AI is being used to centralize power today.

Virginia would bar any agency of the Commonwealth from issuing permits, licenses, or approvals for data center siting or electric service starting July 1, 2027. Not passed.

124 measures in 33 jurisdictions would pause data centers, or add conditions on building and running them.

199 measures in 44 jurisdictions cite the fear that anyone can now fake anyone.

2,272 measures tracked. 760 carry a control, and they would hand new power to 100 offices.
